snippet.title: Streamers Are TURNING Against GTA 6!!
snippet.description:
GTA 6 received a 99 on Metacritic. Critics called it one of the greatest games ever made.

But when the biggest streamers finally played it, not everyone was impressed.

Asmongold complained about the story but gave the game a 9/10. Nick Eh 30 admitted he was bored after just four hours. xQc struggled with the 30 FPS performance, while Jasontheween lost ELEVEN HOURS of progress after accidentally turning off his console.

So is GTA 6 really as good as everyone says?

In this documentary, we explore:

Why GTA 6 received a 99 on Metacritic

xQc's reaction to the 30 FPS performance

Why streamers were disappointed with the PS5 Pro

TheBurntPeanut's performance problems

Jasontheween losing 11 hours of gameplay

Why Nick Eh 30 called GTA 6 boring

Asmongold's infamous "Cuck Simulator" reaction

Why Asmongold criticized Jason and Lucia's relationship

The controversy surrounding GTA 6's writing

Why Asmongold eventually gave GTA 6 a 9/10

Whether GTA 6 deserves Game of the Year

With millions watching the launch, the biggest debate wasn't about who finished the game first.

It was about whether GTA 6 actually lived up to 13 years of expectations.

So who's right: the critics, Nick Eh 30, or Asmongold?

Subscribe to The Fame Desk for more documentaries about gaming, streamers, and internet culture.

#GTA6 #Asmongold #NickEh30

snippet.title: Streamers Are CRASHING OUT On GTA 6
snippet.description:
The honeymoon period for GTA 6 is wearing off fast. The Side Scrollers crew sits down to review the early hours of gameplay and react to streamers losing their minds over the game. From running domestic chores and buying groceries for Lucia to 30 FPS drops, simplified cop chases, and sanitized content, the panel discusses why creators like xQc, Stable Ronaldo, Nick Eh 30, and Action Man are clashing over whether Rockstar's biggest release ever is actually a masterpiece or a massive disappointment.

00:00 - Initial reactions: 8 hours in & high expectations
01:08 - The "domestic chore simulator" & doing errands for Lucia
02:16 - Simplified cop chases & wanted star issues
03:24 - 30 FPS target & performance dips on PS5 Pro
03:52 - Sanitized gameplay & missing classic GTA elements
05:28 - xQc on the "slow burn" defense: Does the opening suck?
06:23 - The panel debates slow burns vs. immediate hooks
10:02 - Is GTA 6 built for normies instead of hardcore fans?
12:42 - Gated progression: Unlocking weapons & key mechanics
15:30 - Media backlash & journalists defending the game
16:21 - "Prestige TV" vs. real open-world freedom
17:31 - Adriana Chechik's viral take on linear storytelling
19:50 - Do relationship chores determine the game's endings?
21:40 - Stable Ronaldo hits the halfway mark: "Not better than GTA 5"
24:35 - Nick Eh 30's deleted critique & xQc's pushback
26:45 - xQc's NoPixel connection & streamer damage control
28:00 - NPC interactivity: Broken promises or hype illusion?
29:05 - Action Man crashes out completely over GTA 6

If you're a normal man, you've found a home for sanity.
